# nemo_stack (Data Source)

A stack its target has, deployed by nemo or by Terraform elsewhere: its installations, from their records on the target. Reading it changes nothing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A stack nemo deployed, read on the provider's Docker.
data "nemo_stack" "shop" {
  name = "shop"
}

output "api_version" {
  value = one([for installation in data.nemo_stack.shop.installations : installation.version if installation.name == "api"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The stack's name.

### Optional

- `context` (String) A docker context to reach the target with, instead of `host`.
- `host` (String) The address of the target's Docker: `tcp://`, `ssh://user@host` or `unix://`. With neither `host` nor `context`, the provider's, with its `tls`; else the environment's.

### Read-Only

- `installations` (Attributes List) The stack's installations, those uninstalled left out. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--installations))
- `orchestrator` (String) `swarm` or `compose`, which deployed the stack.

<a id="nestedatt--installations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `installations`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Its last action, such as `install` or `upgrade`.
- `file` (String) The bundle's `bundle.json`, when it came from one.
- `name` (String) The installation's name.
- `repository` (String) The bundle's repository, when it came from a registry.
- `result` (String) How its last action went, as CNAB says it: `succeeded`, `failed`, `running`…
- `version` (String) The version of the bundle its last action ran.
